_about: Printed notes for cooked dishes come from data/recipes/<slug>.json, which the brief does not let teams edit. Set these keys on the named dishes there.

Italian market bites.note: Provolone, chargrilled eggplant, olive and roasted pepper skewers with Italian bread and oil
Italian market bites.how: Cut the provolone into cubes. Thread onto toothpicks with a folded strip of chargrilled eggplant, an olive and a strip of roasted capsicum. Pile onto a board with sliced Italian bread and a small bowl of olive oil for dipping.

Dragon task chilli bites.note: Crisp haloumi glazed with honey and chilli, on toothpicks. Hungarian Horntail heat
Dragon task chilli bites.how: Cut the haloumi into bite-size cubes and pat dry. Fry in the oil in a hot pan until golden on two sides. Add the honey and chilli and toss until sticky. Squeeze over lemon and spear onto toothpicks.

Warbucks mansion canapés.note: Creamy mushroom and leek pastry cases, plus asparagus wrapped in prosciutto
Warbucks mansion canapés.how: Bake the vol-au-vent cases until crisp. Slice the mushrooms and fry with the leek in butter until browned and soft. Add the cream and thyme and reduce until thick, then fill the cases. Blanch the asparagus and wrap each spear in half a slice of prosciutto.

Hotel tea sandwiches.note: Egg and cress, cucumber cream cheese, and beetroot and dill finger sandwiches
Hotel tea sandwiches.how: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise and cress. Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with a squeeze of lemon. Use the white bread to make cucumber and cream cheese, egg, and beetroot, cream cheese and dill sandwiches. Cut off the crusts and cut into fingers. Lay on a tiered stand.

Zarkov's rocket fuel curry.note: Red curry prawns with coconut milk, red capsicum and Thai basil. Fuel for the rocket ship
Zarkov's rocket fuel curry.how: Fry the curry paste in the oil until fragrant. Add the prawns and brown. Pour in the coconut milk and simmer, adding the capsicum for the last 5 minutes. Cook the rice. Stir the Thai basil through the curry and serve with the rice.

Adrian's restaurant antipasto.note: Chargrilled eggplant, provolone, warm olives, artichokes, roasted peppers and Italian bread
Adrian's restaurant antipasto.how: Fold the chargrilled eggplant and provolone onto a big board. Warm the olives gently in olive oil and spoon over. Add the artichoke hearts and strips of roasted capsicum. Tear the bread for mopping up the oil.

Lake Como antipasto.note: Bresaola, burrata, chargrilled zucchini, figs, rocket and olives with breadsticks
Lake Como antipasto.how: Brush the zucchini with a little of the oil, salt it and chargrill until striped and tender. Lay the bresaola on a board with the burrata, halved figs, breadsticks and olives. Drizzle with good olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

Trail cornbread.note: Buttermilk cornbread with sweet corn and smoked paprika, baked in a hot skillet
Trail cornbread.how: Heat the oven to 220C with a cast iron pan inside, then melt the butter in the hot pan. Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, smoked paprika, egg and buttermilk. Stir in the corn. Pour into the hot buttered pan and bake. Serve with butter.
